scenario_description: Riverbend Market regularly has unsold bakery items near closing, creating an optional opportunity to reduce waste and help a local food-rescue group. A food-rescue route has newly available capacity, and Lena's evening team could stage eligible items before closing without disrupting store operations. After a second inventory observation confirms that the surplus is recurring, the opportunity becomes sufficiently clear to justify proactively proposing a small pilot, confirming owner approval, and coordinating the handling details. Ignoring it would not cause a failure, but acting could reduce discarded food, support the community, and give Lena a practical improvement to report to the store owner.

parameters: 8:45 PM: After the evening rush, 14 loaves of sandwich bread and 8 packages of dinner rolls remain unsold. All are sealed and within their sell-by dates. The team will record the final count during closing.

parameter.subject: A possible Riverbend food-rescue pickup
parameter.body: Our Tuesday neighborhood route has room for one more grocery partner beginning next week. We can accept sealed bread and dinner rolls that are still within their sell-by dates. A participating store would need to set the items aside for our driver near the end of its evening shift. If Riverbend is interested, I can send the exact handoff window and storage instructions.

parameters: 8:50 PM: A second evening count found 16 loaves of sandwich bread and 7 packages of dinner rolls still unsold. The items are sealed, within their sell-by dates, and would otherwise be removed during closing. The repeated surplus appears large enough for a small donation trial.

parameter.content: The bakery surplus you mentioned could be worth trying as a short pilot. I am open to approving it, but send me a simple proposal with the expected item types, who will stage them, and when the handoff would happen so I can confirm it fits our closing routine.

parameter.subject: Details for the Tuesday rescue route
parameter.body: For a Riverbend pilot, our driver can arrive Tuesdays between 9:45 PM and 10:05 PM. Please place sealed bread and dinner rolls in labeled boxes in the rear receiving area; refrigeration is not needed for this short handoff. The driver can take up to 30 packages per visit, and we can start Tuesday, April 14 if the store confirms the pilot by Monday afternoon.
